actions.reason: BasicTokenizer.train now keeps a lazy max-heap of pair counts and updates it as counts change, avoiding a full values list and scan on every merge. The pair-count update also counts neighboring tokens directly instead of constructing slice strings through itemgetter. RegexTokenizer.train tie handling avoids re-adding the selected tied pair and uses set membership while collecting ties.
